purpose: Construct a balanced, reproducible first research/distillation tranche from remaining post-Qin CORE rulers after P0 closes.
non_goal: Do not score, rank, tier, endorse, or judge rulers or political figures. This file schedules corpus work only.

evidence_state.meaning: State of the available evidence base, not a judgment of the person.

source_review_complete.meaning: Whether a source-oriented review has been completed sufficiently to begin research/distillation.

transition_contexts.meaning: Documented contexts such as founding, conquest, restoration, succession rupture, fragmentation, collapse, or negotiated transfer; descriptive only.

comparison_links.meaning: Named corpus comparison opportunities recorded without declaring a winner or higher-value figure.

simulation_contexts.meaning: Potential future simulation/visualization contexts, recorded descriptively rather than scored.

evidence_pointers.meaning: Source/research pointers supporting the review annotations.

review_sequence.multi_polity_rule: a person appears once at their first deterministic slot
review_sequence.warning: Sequence numbers are queue positions, not ranks or evaluations.

selection.rule: Finalize the initial tranche only from source-review-complete candidates following the deterministic review sequence and only after the diversity floor is met.
guardrails: No numerical person score, weighted total, tier, winner, or historical-worth ranking.
Do not promote REVIEW/EXTENDED/LEGENDARY entries into P1.
LIMITED evidence is valid when downstream model claims are correspondingly constrained.
Every completed source review carries evidence pointers or an explicit evidence note.
Machine signals may organize work but never become a judgment about a ruler.
